evidence.notes: HttpCalloutMock lifecycle in local test context

source.content: @isTest private class TestHelperFixtureTest { @isTest static void helpers() { System.assert(Test.isRunningTest()); System.assertEquals('01s000000000001', Test.getStandardPricebookId()); ApexPages.addMessage(new ApexPages.Message('ERROR', 'Summary', 'Detail')); System.assert(ApexPages.hasMessages()); System.assertEquals(1, ApexPages.getMessages().size()); Test.clearApexPageMessages(); System.assert(!ApexPages.hasMessages()); System.assertEquals(0, ApexPages.getMessages().size()); Test.setMock('HttpCalloutMock', new MockResponse(body = 'fixture', statusCode = 209)); HttpRequest req = new HttpRequest(); req.setEndpoint('https://example.test'); req.setMethod('GET'); Http h = new Http(); HttpResponse res = h.send(req); System.assertEquals(209, res.getStatusCode()); System.assertEquals('fixture', res.getBody()); } }
